rule: Next ~40 unread open/thin marks files. Prefer remaining empty-cert companies that already store a first-party trust / security / privacy URL. That queue is exhausted after PRIOR (including leftover instrument walks 120–153), so this cut fills from the latest expand's silent/unread rows that have a domain. Well-known first-party privacy / security / trust / compliance paths are live-fetched. Marks fill only when that HTML names the company's own hold. Regulation mentions (GDPR/CCPA as rights) and DPF as a transfer mechanism among SCCs stay open. Login walls, soft-404s, homepage bounces, PDFs, JS shells, and portal hosts stay open.
